name: koalafix-auto
description: Makes KoalaFix automatic in Cursor: the team brief and current decisions at session start, recall on each prompt, a warning before the agent edits a file a teammate has checked in on, work in progress started and closed for you. Install it beside the koalafix plugin. Sends each prompt (keys and tokens taken out, never logged) and the paths of files it names or the session edits to your KoalaFix server; teammates see your project, branch and those paths. Needs Node.js 22 or later.
